title: “Di Ting” Customer Service Agent
summary: Hubei Telecom reports that Di Ting shortened new-agent training from three months to one week and reduced average handling time by 10%.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Di Ting assists agents with intent recognition, information retrieval, and service actions in Hubei Telecom’s customer-service center. The source reports shorter training and handling time, faster workflow changes, and favorable user surveys. The claims describe operational and cohort-level improvements without independent validation in the reviewed source.
purpose: Help customer-service personnel learn and complete telecom service tasks.
deployer: Hubei Customer Service Center, China Telecom

ratings.reason: Hubei Telecom reports training shortened from three months to one week and handling time reduced by 10%, supporting operational time savings.
New-agent cohorts reportedly complete training in one week rather than three months; the documented magnitude is time saved, without a separate learning-quality comparison.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 7: “Di Ting” Customer Service Agent

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: Di Ting shortens customer-service training and handling time

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
